clauses.reason: Lead of Sec. 1: lists the prohibited importation, promotion, dealing and exportation activities in items (a) to (e), notwithstanding international agreements and prior contracts. Ends with the order: EO 12932 (signed 1994-10-14; 59 FR 52403, Federal Register of October 18, 1994) revokes this order by number ("I hereby revoke Executive Order Nos. 12775, 12779, 12853, 12872, 12914," 12917, 12920, and 12922, and terminates the national emergency declared in EO 12775) and provides "This order shall take effect at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on October" 16, 1994, so the end is 1994-10-16.

conflict_resolutions.FULL_AND_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT: The dossier flags that the sources read as both a whole and a partial ending for EO 12932. Resolution: EO 12932 revokes this order by number in a single sentence that names eight orders and also terminates the national emergency declared in EO 12775, so it is a whole ending. Earlier partial provisions held for some of these orders (revocations to the extent inconsistent in later Haiti orders) are recorded as later events of the clauses they touch; each is conditional on inconsistency and none is shown to extinguish a clause, so none is an end.

research_rationale:
EO 12917 of May 21, 1994 (Prohibiting Certain Transactions With Respect to Haiti), read in full in the held Federal Register text (59 FR 26925, Federal Register of May 24, 1994; machine-extracted text layer). Identity: number, date and subject agree with the census register row (1994-05-21). The order prohibits imports from and exports to Haiti with exemptions, bars evasion, incorporates definitions, authorizes Treasury regulations, partially revokes two earlier orders and states its effective time. Inventory correction: the dossier inventory stops inside item (d)(ii) and omits item (e) and Sec. 2 to 6; I re-marked fourteen clauses on the held text. EO 12932 revokes the order by number effective 12:01 a.m. EDT October 16, 1994; the dossier's located-provision gaps (EO 12920, EO 12932) are orders held and read that do not change this order other than EO 12932's revocation. Searches: the dossier's three machine searches (U.S. Code release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 with GovInfo CFR bulk XML; Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition notes and operative sentences of 17,521 saved order texts) were chosen after reading their coverage notes, which carry no scope warning. Machine hits for this order: current-law:usc 0, current-law:ecfr 0, later-events:ofr_catalog 5. The packet's by-number scan of held order texts (LOOKUPS) was read for this order; no held text other than EO 12932 changes it; EO 12779 and EO 12853 are the orders it partially revokes.

Those preserved effects, and any Treasury regulations or licenses issued under the order, are accrued consequences or separate administrative acts; they are not commands of this order.
